 Lecce host Genoa at the Stadio Via del Mare in the capital of Salento at 6pm on Sunday, in the penultimate fixture of matchday 10 of the 2026/27 Serie A season . Eusebio Di Francesco's Lecce are battling an injury crisis after a heavy defeat in Frosinone and need vital points in the fight to avoid relegation. Daniele De Rossi's Genoa have bounced back with an emphatic 2-0 home win over Juventus, but have yet to pick up a point away from home.

 GENOA (3-5-2) : Bijlow; Marcandalli, Østigård, Vásquez; Ellertsson, Frendrup, Wiafe, Traore, El Shaarawy; Messias, Osmajic. Manager: De Rossi 
 Referee: Marchetti
 Booked: -
 Sent off: -
 Goals and highlights
 11' GOAL: Lecce make a mess of playing out, giving Genoa the ball and sending Messias through. After a scramble, El Shaarawy's cross is blocked and the ball falls back to Messias. He crosses first time, and Osmajic side-foots home from the centre of the box, beating Falcone.
 0' Kick-off at the Via del Mare at 18:00.
